name: cf-form
title: CF Form
description: Modal form dialog with 14+ field types including text, email, textarea, number, date, checkbox, select, multi-select, password, rich text, file, image, and masked input.
author: GT264 <ferretti.m91@gmail.com>
docs: This form supports 14 field types: text, email, textarea, number, date, checkbox, select, multi_select, password, rich_text, file, image, mask. For rich_text (tiptap), file/image (VueUse), and mask (Maska) types, the corresponding crud-fiesta input wrappers will be installed as dependencies.
